title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
title_zh: 视觉-语言智能体可以在自身潜在世界中学习

paragraphs.en: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent’s interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we introduce Dwell , a model-based reinforcement learning (RL) framework that reframes a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, endowing it with the ability to predict, adjust, and act in latent space. Leveraging the VLM’s own representations and its dual role as both world model and policy, the agent continually learns from real interactions to anticipate and evaluate action outcomes, and from latent imagination to improve its behavior. Across five interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves the strongest overall performance among trainable methods while substantially reducing the compute required for imagination, showing that effective world models for VLM agents need not reconstruct the future—they need to predict futures that are useful for action. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tom111-lhx/Dwell .

paragraphs.en: AI agents ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) have acquired broad capabilities through large-scale pretraining on human-generated data ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Hoffmann et al., 2022 ) and post-training with human demonstrations and preference feedback ( Ziegler et al., 2019 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . Extending this progress beyond the limits of human-provided data ( Villalobos et al., 2024 ) motivates agents that continually learn from experience generated through their own interactions with the environment ( Silver & Sutton, 2025 ) . Recent work ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) has taken steps in this direction by using reinforcement learning (RL) to improve agents’ multi-step decision-making with environmental feedback. However, the substantial environment interaction often required by model-free approaches can make experience collection a bottleneck to scaling ( Janner et al., 2019 ; Chandra et al., 2025 ) . This raises a central question: how can agents achieve greater policy improvement from limited real experience?
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体（OpenAI, 2026；Team et al., 2026）通过在人类生成数据上进行大规模预训练（Brown et al., 2020；Hoffmann et al., 2022），以及利用人类演示和偏好反馈进行后训练（Ziegler et al., 2019；Ouyang et al., 2022），已经获得了广泛的能力。 为了将这一进展扩展到人类提供数据的限制之外（Villalobos et al., 2024），人们希望智能体能够持续地从其自身与环境交互所产生的经验中学习（Silver & Sutton, 2025）。 近期的工作（Wang et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）已经朝这个方向迈出了步伐，通过使用强化学习（RL）借助环境反馈来改进智能体的多步决策能力。 然而，无模型方法通常所需的大量环境交互可能使经验收集成为扩展的瓶颈（Janner et al., 2019；Chandra et al., 2025）。 这引出了一个核心问题：智能体如何才能从有限的真实经验中获得更大的策略提升？

paragraphs.en: World models offer a way to learn more from real experience by predicting action outcomes and generating imagined trajectories for policy learning. For vision-language model (VLM) agents, models that synthesize observations have already served as training environments across embodied and web tasks ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, imagination in a compact latent space avoids reconstructing observations at every predicted step ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) , while predictive representation learning can emphasize predictable structure over incidental visual detail ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Maes et al., 2026 ) . Pretrained VLMs already encode rich world knowledge, suggesting that their own representations could support latent imagination for policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型通过预测动作结果并生成用于策略学习的想象轨迹，提供了一种从真实经验中学习更多知识的方法。 对于视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体而言，能够合成观测的模型已经在具身任务和网络任务中充当训练环境（Zhu et al., 2026；Fang et al., 2025）。 相比之下，在紧凑的潜在空间中进行想象可以避免在每一步预测时重建观测（Hafner et al., 2019；Hafner et al., 2023），而预测式表征学习可以强调可预测的结构而非偶然的视觉细节（Assran et al., 2023；Maes et al., 2026）。 预训练的视觉语言模型已经编码了丰富的世界知识，这表明它们自身的表征可以支持用于策略学习的潜在想象。

paragraphs.en: Accurate prediction alone does not guarantee compatibility: a world model’s latent states may not be readily usable by a VLM policy, even when they faithfully capture action outcomes ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . A further difficulty arises as policy updates shift the agent’s interaction distribution toward states and actions poorly covered by the world model’s training data ( Janner et al., 2019 ) . In these regions, errors in predicted transitions and rewards can bias subsequent policy updates, so gains in imagination may not translate into better behavior in the environment ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Adapting to this evolving distribution can also be computationally expensive when it requires repeated updates to a large pretrained VLM. Together, these challenges motivate a shared representational basis for prediction and decision-making, coupled with efficient, continual correction of transition and reward predictions from real interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 仅有准确的预测并不能保证兼容性：世界模型的潜在状态未必能被 VLM 策略直接使用，即使它们忠实地刻画了动作的结果（Assran et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2026）。 还有一个进一步的困难：策略更新会使智能体的交互分布偏向世界模型训练数据覆盖不佳的状态和动作（Janner et al., 2019）。 在这些区域中，预测的状态转移和奖励中的误差可能会使后续的策略更新产生偏差，因此想象力方面的提升未必能转化为环境中更好的行为（Liu et al., 2026）。 当适应这一不断演变的分布需要对大型预训练 VLM 进行反复更新时，其计算代价也可能十分高昂。 综合来看，这些挑战促使我们寻求一种为预测与决策所共享的表征基础，并辅以从真实交互中对状态转移和奖励预测进行高效、持续的校正。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Dwell , a model-based RL framework that enables VLMs to predict, adjust, and act in their own latent space. By recasting the VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, we equip it to reason about the state of the world from interaction history and improve its behavior through latent imagination. Following the joint-embedding principle ( Assran et al., 2023 ) , our method draws on the VLM’s rich world knowledge to actively infer a state representation in an abstract and compact space, rather than focusing on every detail of the observation. Exploiting the VLM’s dual role as a world model and policy, we instantiate both components using separate lightweight LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on the same VLM backbone, allowing independent, parameter-efficient adaptation while sharing a common representation interface. Together, recurrence and duality provide a unified framework for modeling and acting in dynamic environments through online learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Dwell，一个基于模型的强化学习框架，使视觉语言模型（VLM）能够在自己的潜空间中进行预测、调整和行动。 通过将 VLM 重新构建为一个循环的潜空间状态转移算子，我们使其能够从交互历史中推理世界状态，并通过潜空间想象改进自身行为。 遵循联合嵌入原则（Assran et al., 2023），我们的方法利用 VLM 丰富的世界知识，在一个抽象而紧凑的空间中主动推断状态表示，而不是关注观测中的每一个细节。 利用 VLM 作为世界模型和策略的双重角色，我们在同一个 VLM 主干上使用两个独立的轻量级 LoRA 适配器（Hu et al., 2022）来实例化这两个组件，从而在共享统一表示接口的同时实现独立且参数高效的自适应。 循环性与对偶性共同提供了一个统一框架，可通过在线学习在动态环境中进行建模与行动。

paragraphs.en: A self-evolving agent should anticipate the consequences of its actions and use feedback from interaction to continually refine its predictions and behavior. Although VLMs have acquired rich world knowledge, they tend to be brittle when exposed to dynamic environments or when learning from experience. Our method, Dwell , anchors a VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator, morphing a static perceiver into an active predictor. Given streams of observations and actions from online interaction, it infers the most explainable states in the VLM’s own latent space, which can in turn be used for model-based planning in the absence of feedback. This cycle of interaction, refinement, and improvement enables the agent to continuously expand its understanding of the environment while adapting its actions accordingly.

paragraphs.en: Learning a world model improves sample efficiency, enables planning and foresight, and enhances adaptability to environmental changes. The central questions are: (1) what state representation a good world model requires; and (2) how to make reliable predictions into the future to guide action selection. When faced with complex or high-dimensional observations, a naive approach is to optimize for reconstruction fidelity in the original space. However, this can be problematic, as it focuses too much on information that is redundant or irrelevant to solving the task, while also being computationally inefficient. VLMs can internalize rich knowledge in their latent space, providing us with a good starting point to build upon. We can leverage this internalized knowledge by operating in a compact latent space while attending only to the information most relevant to decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 学习世界模型能够提升样本效率，支持规划与前瞻，并增强对环境变化的适应能力。 核心问题包括：(1) 一个好的世界模型需要什么样的状态表示；(2) 如何对未来做出可靠预测以指导动作选择。 当面对复杂或高维的观测时，一种朴素的做法是在原始空间中优化重建保真度。 然而，这种做法可能存在问题，因为它过度关注冗余的或与解决任务无关的信息，同时在计算上也效率低下。 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够在其潜在空间中内化丰富的知识，为我们提供了一个良好的构建起点。 我们可以通过在紧凑的潜在空间中进行操作，并且只关注与决策最相关的信息，来利用这种内化的知识。

sents.zh: 核心问题包括：(1) 一个好的世界模型需要什么样的状态表示；(2) 如何对未来做出可靠预测以指导动作选择。

sents.en: When faced with complex or high-dimensional observations, a naive approach is to optimize for reconstruction fidelity in the original space.
sents.zh: 当面对复杂或高维的观测时，一种朴素的做法是在原始空间中优化重建保真度。

sents.en: However, this can be problematic, as it focuses too much on information that is redundant or irrelevant to solving the task, while also being computationally inefficient.
sents.zh: 然而，这种做法可能存在问题，因为它过度关注冗余的或与解决任务无关的信息，同时在计算上也效率低下。

sents.en: VLMs can internalize rich knowledge in their latent space, providing us with a good starting point to build upon.
sents.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够在其潜在空间中内化丰富的知识，为我们提供了一个良好的构建起点。

sents.en: We can leverage this internalized knowledge by operating in a compact latent space while attending only to the information most relevant to decision-making.
sents.zh: 我们可以通过在紧凑的潜在空间中进行操作，并且只关注与决策最相关的信息，来利用这种内化的知识。

paragraphs.en: When explicit feedback is absent, the world model needs to make reliable predictions into the future for planning and foresight. The posterior, in contrast, infers the states that best explain the current observation given the history, providing a natural learning target for the prior and thereby equipping the VLM with the ability to predict and adjust.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Dwell across diverse interactive visual environments to examine whether latent imagination improves task performance and learning efficiency while remaining computationally practical.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多种多样的交互式视觉环境中评估 Dwell，以检验潜在想象能否在保持计算可行性的同时提升任务性能与学习效率。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on five interactive visual environments spanning complementary decision-making regimes: Sokoban , FrozenLake , Navigation , PrimitiveSkill , and EB-ALFRED . Sokoban ( Schrader, 2018 ) and FrozenLake ( Towers et al., 2024 ) test spatial reasoning and multi-step planning in discrete visual environments; Navigation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ) evaluates embodied navigation from first-person observations; PrimitiveSkill ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2022 ) tests visually grounded manipulation; and EB-ALFRED ( Yang et al., 2025 ) extends the evaluation to long-horizon compositional embodied tasks. Together, these environments cover increasingly complex forms of partial observability, action consequence prediction, and long-horizon decision making. We use task success rate as the primary metric and, unless otherwise specified, report the mean and standard deviation over three independent training seeds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个互补决策机制的交互式视觉环境中进行评估：Sokoban、FrozenLake、Navigation、PrimitiveSkill 和 EB-ALFRED。 Sokoban（Schrader, 2018）和 FrozenLake（Towers et al., 2024）测试离散视觉环境中的空间推理与多步规划；Navigation（Yang et al., 2025; Kolve et al., 2017）基于第一人称观测评估具身导航；PrimitiveSkill（Tao et al., 2024; Nasiriany et al., 2022）测试视觉基础操作；EB-ALFRED（Yang et al., 2025）则将评估扩展到长程组合式具身任务。 这些环境共同涵盖了日益复杂的部分可观测性、动作后果预测以及长程决策形式。 我们以任务成功率为主要指标，除非另有说明，否则报告三个独立训练随机种子上的均值和标准差。

sents.en: We evaluate on five interactive visual environments spanning complementary decision-making regimes: Sokoban , FrozenLake , Navigation , PrimitiveSkill , and EB-ALFRED .

sents.en: Sokoban ( Schrader, 2018 ) and FrozenLake ( Towers et al., 2024 ) test spatial reasoning and multi-step planning in discrete visual environments; Navigation ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kolve et al., 2017 ) evaluates embodied navigation from first-person observations; PrimitiveSkill ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Nasiriany et al., 2022 ) tests visually grounded manipulation; and EB-ALFRED ( Yang et al., 2025 ) extends the evaluation to long-horizon compositional embodied tasks.
sents.zh: Sokoban（Schrader, 2018）和 FrozenLake（Towers et al., 2024）测试离散视觉环境中的空间推理与多步规划；Navigation（Yang et al., 2025; Kolve et al., 2017）基于第一人称观测评估具身导航；PrimitiveSkill（Tao et al., 2024; Nasiriany et al., 2022）测试视觉基础操作；EB-ALFRED（Yang et al., 2025）则将评估扩展到长程组合式具身任务。

sents.en: Together, these environments cover increasingly complex forms of partial observability, action consequence prediction, and long-horizon decision making.
sents.zh: 这些环境共同涵盖了日益复杂的部分可观测性、动作后果预测以及长程决策形式。

sents.en: We use task success rate as the primary metric and, unless otherwise specified, report the mean and standard deviation over three independent training seeds.
sents.zh: 我们以任务成功率为主要指标，除非另有说明，否则报告三个独立训练随机种子上的均值和标准差。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( Bai et al., 2023 ) as the unified VLM backbone for all trainable agent methods. We compare Dwell against model-free online RL with PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) and GRPO ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , which optimize the policy directly from environmental feedback without imagined experience. For model-based RL, we adapt LeWorldModel to our online agent setting by connecting its learned latent dynamics to the same VLM policy and online interaction pipeline; the adaptation is detailed in Appendix A.2 . We additionally report strong off-the-shelf VLMs as reference points without online adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B（Bai et al., 2023）作为所有可训练智能体方法的统一 VLM 主干。 我们将 Dwell 与采用 PPO（Schulman et al., 2017）和 GRPO（Guo et al., 2025）的无模型在线强化学习进行比较，后者直接根据环境反馈优化策略，而无需想象经验。 对于基于模型的强化学习，我们通过将其学习到的潜在动态连接到相同的 VLM 策略和在线交互流程，将 LeWorldModel 改造以适应我们的在线智能体设置；具体改造细节见附录 A.2。 我们还报告了强大的现成 VLM 作为参考基线，这些模型未经在线适配。

As shown in Table 1 , Dwell achieves the best overall performance among trainable methods, substantially improving the same Qwen2.5-VL-3B initialization. The gains are most evident on Sokoban , FrozenLake , and the long-horizon EB-ALFRED tasks, where successful decisions depend strongly on anticipating how current actions alter future states. This pattern supports our central hypothesis that action-conditioned latent imagination can turn limited real experience into useful additional training experience.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 1 所示，Dwell 在可训练方法中取得了最佳的整体性能，相比相同的 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 初始化有了显著提升。 这些收益在 Sokoban、FrozenLake 以及长时程 EB-ALFRED 任务上最为明显，在这些任务中，成功的决策很大程度上取决于预判当前动作会如何改变未来状态。 这一模式支持了我们的核心假设，即以动作为条件的潜在想象能够将有限的真实经验转化为有用的额外训练经验。

paragraphs.en: The benefit is task dependent rather than uniform. Model-free GRPO remains stronger on Navigation and slightly better on PrimitiveSkill . We attribute this difference to two distinct regimes: in navigation, immediate visual observations often provide strong action cues, reducing the marginal benefit of explicit future-state prediction; in contact-rich manipulation, useful imagination requires finer-grained dynamics that are harder to preserve in a compact latent rollout. In contrast, Dwell consistently improves over the adapted LeWorldModel baseline, suggesting that effective model-based learning depends not only on learning latent dynamics, but also on making predicted states directly usable by the VLM policy. We examine the efficiency of these gains and the role of each component below.
paragraphs.zh: 这一收益取决于具体任务，而非普遍一致。 无模型的 GRPO 在 Navigation 上仍然更强，在 PrimitiveSkill 上也略胜一筹。 我们将这一差异归因于两种不同的机制：在导航中，即时的视觉观察往往能提供强烈的动作线索，从而降低了显式未来状态预测的边际收益；而在接触丰富的操作任务中，有用的想象需要更细粒度的动力学，这在紧凑的潜在空间展开中更难保留。 相比之下，Dwell 始终优于适配后的 LeWorldModel 基线，这表明有效的基于模型的学习不仅依赖于学习潜在动力学，还依赖于让预测状态能够被 VLM 策略直接使用。 我们在下文中检验这些收益的效率以及每个组件的作用。

paragraphs.en: Across both Sokoban and FrozenLake , Dwell reaches higher success rates than the alternative model-based approaches. The advantage is particularly clear on FrozenLake , where the competing methods improve only gradually while Dwell continues to benefit from interaction. These results suggest that recurrent latent imagination provides useful additional learning signal from experience already collected, rather than relying solely on new environment rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Sokoban 和 FrozenLake 两个环境中，Dwell 都达到了比其他基于模型的方法更高的成功率。 这一优势在 FrozenLake 上尤为明显：竞争方法只能逐步缓慢提升，而 Dwell 持续从交互中获益。 这些结果表明，循环式潜在想象能够从已收集的经验中提供有用的额外学习信号，而不必完全依赖新的环境采样。

paragraphs.en: We further measure the end-to-end GPU-hours required to reach the final training step used in each environment, including all GPU computation incurred by online training, such as world-model updates, imagined rollouts, and policy/value optimization. As shown in Figure 3 , LeWorldModel remains the least expensive approach due to its compact latent dynamics. Nevertheless, Dwell consistently requires substantially less computation than AdaWorld , reducing GPU-hours by approximately 38 38 – 58 % 58\% across the four evaluated environments. It also incurs lower total compute than PPO and GRPO under the same training schedule. Taken together with the performance results in Table 1 , these findings indicate that Dwell achieves a favorable performance–compute trade-off: it retains the efficiency of latent-space imagination while avoiding the considerably higher cost of generating future visual observations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步测量了在每个环境中达到最终训练步骤所需的端到端 GPU 小时数，包括在线训练产生的所有 GPU 计算，例如世界模型更新、想象回放以及策略/价值优化。 如图 3 所示，LeWorldModel 由于其紧凑的潜在动态，仍然是成本最低的方法。 尽管如此，Dwell 始终所需的计算量明显少于 AdaWorld，在四个评估环境中将 GPU 小时数减少了约 38 38 – 58 % 58\%。 在相同的训练计划下，它的总计算量也低于 PPO 和 GRPO。 结合表 1 中的性能结果来看，这些发现表明 Dwell 实现了良好的性能—计算权衡：它保留了潜在空间想象的效率，同时避免了生成未来视觉观测所带来的高得多的成本。

paragraphs.en: We ablate two aspects of Dwell that are central to learning from latent imagination: the supervision used to construct predictive latent states and the continual adaptation of the world model during online policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 Dwell 的两个方面进行了消融实验，这两个方面对于从潜在想象中学习至关重要：用于构建预测性潜在状态的监督信号，以及在线策略学习过程中世界模型的持续适应。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 , removing either predictive dynamics learning or representation grounding degrades performance on both Sokoban and Navigation . The degradation is substantially larger without ℒ dyn \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dyn}} , indicating that direct supervision of action-conditioned future states is essential for producing useful imagined trajectories. Removing ℒ rep \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}} yields a smaller but consistent drop, showing that predictive consistency alone is insufficient and benefits from anchoring the latent state to perceptually meaningful visual representations. Together, the two objectives play complementary roles: ℒ dyn \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dyn}} learns how the state evolves under actions, whereas ℒ rep \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}} constrains what information the state should preserve.
paragraphs.zh: 如图4所示，去除预测动力学学习或表征接地中的任何一项，都会降低智能体在Sokoban和Navigation两个任务上的性能。 在没有ℒ dyn \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dyn}}的情况下，性能下降幅度明显更大，这表明对动作条件下的未来状态进行直接监督，对于生成有用的想象轨迹至关重要。 去除ℒ rep \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}会带来较小但持续的下降，这说明仅靠预测一致性是不够的，还需要将潜在状态锚定到具有感知意义的视觉表征上。 总的来说，这两个目标发挥着互补作用：ℒ dyn \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{dyn}}学习状态在动作下如何演化，而ℒ rep \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}则约束状态应当保留哪些信息。

paragraphs.en: We further freeze the world model after its initial fitting and continue policy optimization with the resulting fixed dynamics. The frozen model remains competitive early in training, but its performance quickly saturates on both Sokoban and FrozenLake , whereas the full Dwell continues to improve as additional interaction is collected. This behavior is consistent with a policy-induced distribution shift: as the policy changes, it visits state–action regions that are increasingly different from those used to fit the initial model. Continually refreshing the world model with newly collected experience therefore keeps imagined trajectories aligned with the evolving policy distribution and enables sustained policy improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步在世界模型完成初始拟合后将其冻结，并利用所得的固定动力学继续进行策略优化。 冻结模型在训练早期仍具竞争力，但其性能在 Sokoban 和 FrozenLake 上都很快趋于饱和，而完整的 Dwell 则随着收集到更多交互数据持续改进。 这种行为与策略引发的分布偏移相一致：随着策略的变化，智能体所访问的状态-动作区域与用于拟合初始模型的区域差异越来越大。 因此，利用新收集的经验不断刷新世界模型，可以使想象轨迹与不断演化的策略分布保持一致，并实现持续的策略改进。

paragraphs.en: Model-based RL has long used learned dynamics to augment real experience with prediction and planning. Dreamer learns policies from trajectories imagined in a compact latent state space, while TD-MPC and its successors optimize behavior with decoder-free latent world models ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ) . More recent predictive-representation approaches replace observation reconstruction with latent prediction, enabling action-conditioned planning or policy learning directly in representation space ( Assran et al., 2025 ; Bagatella et al., 2026 ) . These methods establish that control need not operate on reconstructed observations. Our focus is complementary: we study how such a latent learning interface can be built into a VLM agent, so that the representations used for real decisions also form the state space of imagined policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的强化学习长期以来利用学习到的动力学，通过预测与规划来增广真实经验。 Dreamer 从在紧凑隐状态空间中想象的轨迹中学习策略，而 TD-MPC 及其后续工作则使用无解码器的隐世界模型来优化行为（Hafner et al., 2019; Hafner et al., 2023; Hansen et al., 2024）。 更近期的预测表征方法用隐空间预测取代观测重建，使得动作条件下的规划或策略学习可以直接在表征空间中进行（Assran et al., 2025; Bagatella et al., 2026）。 这些方法表明，控制无需作用于重建的观测之上。 我们的关注点是互补的：我们研究如何将这样一种隐空间学习接口构建进视觉-语言模型智能体中，使用于真实决策的表征同时构成想象策略学习的状态空间。

paragraphs.en: Generative world models have recently become practical training environments for large-model agents. In embodied settings, video world models synthesize action-conditioned futures for VLA policy optimization ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ) , while learned web simulators generate interaction experience for self-improvement in browser agents ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . A common design is to adapt the simulator to policy behavior and then hold it fixed while optimizing the policy. This separation makes model-generated experience reusable, but the simulator cannot incorporate new evidence arising during the subsequent policy updates. World-VLA-Loop ( Liu et al., 2026 ) takes a step toward closing this loop by iteratively adding new policy rollouts to world-model training; however, policy learning still proceeds through autoregressively generated visual observations and inherits their long-horizon drift. Dwell instead uses the VLM’s predicted beliefs themselves as the interaction states: policy learning requires neither future-image generation nor re-encoding, and the latent world is refreshed from newly collected real experience throughout training.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式世界模型近期已成为大模型智能体的实用训练环境。 在具身场景中，视频世界模型为VLA策略优化合成动作条件下的未来（Zhu et al., 2026; Jia et al., 2026），而学习得到的网页模拟器则为浏览器智能体的自我改进生成交互经验（Fang et al., 2025; Ding et al., 2026）。 一种常见设计是先将模拟器适配到策略行为，然后在优化策略时将其固定不变。 这种分离使得模型生成的经验可以复用，但模拟器无法吸收后续策略更新过程中出现的新证据。 World-VLA-Loop（Liu et al., 2026）通过迭代地将新的策略轨迹加入世界模型训练，朝着闭合这一循环迈出了一步；然而，策略学习仍然通过自回归生成的视觉观测进行，并继承了其长时程漂移问题。 Dwell 则直接使用 VLM 预测的信念本身作为交互状态：策略学习既不需要生成未来图像，也不需要重新编码，并且潜在世界在整个训练过程中由新收集的真实经验不断刷新。

paragraphs.en: A parallel line of work develops world-modeling capabilities inside the agent itself. VLM representations can provide semantically informed state features for control, and explicit state estimation and transition reasoning can improve multi-turn visual decision-making ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches incorporate future prediction more directly into action learning: VLA-JEPA uses latent state prediction to learn action-relevant representations, and unified world–action models jointly predict observations and actions ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Cen et al., 2025 ) . In these methods, world modeling primarily shapes the representation, reasoning process, or action predictor. Dwell gives the predicted state a different operational role: it is the state on which the policy continues to act and learn. A single frozen VLM backbone therefore supports two trainable roles through separate adapters: one learns action-conditioned latent dynamics, while the other learns the policy, and real interaction continually supervises both the predicted dynamics and their task outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条平行的研究路线则在智能体自身内部发展世界建模能力。 VLM 表征可以为控制提供具有语义信息的状态特征，而显式的状态估计与转移推理能够改善多轮视觉决策（Chen et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026）。 其他方法则将未来预测更直接地融入动作学习：VLA-JEPA 使用潜在状态预测来学习与动作相关的表征，统一的世界—动作模型则联合预测观测与动作（Sun et al., 2026；Cen et al., 2025）。 在这些方法中，世界建模主要影响的是表征、推理过程或动作预测器。 Dwell 赋予预测状态一种不同的操作角色：它是策略持续在其上进行行动和学习的状态。 因此，单个冻结的 VLM 骨干通过独立的适配器支持两个可训练的角色：一个学习动作条件下的潜在动力学，另一个学习策略，而真实交互则持续监督所预测的动力学及其任务结果。

paragraphs.en: The benefit of latent imagination is not uniform across the evaluated tasks. While Dwell shows clear gains on Sokoban , FrozenLake , and EB-ALFRED , its advantage is smaller on Navigation and PrimitiveSkill . This pattern is consistent with the hypothesis that imagination is most useful when predicted future states provide information beyond what is already available from the current observation, whereas its benefit may diminish when action selection is largely observation-driven or depends on dynamics that are difficult to capture compactly. A natural next step is therefore to make imagination selective, allowing the agent to decide when and how far to imagine rather than applying a fixed rollout horizon uniformly across states and tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在想象的好处并非在所有被评估的任务上都一致。 虽然 Dwell 在 Sokoban、FrozenLake 和 EB-ALFRED 上有明显的收益，但它在 Navigation 和 PrimitiveSkill 上的优势较小。 这一模式与以下假设一致：当预测的未来状态能提供超出当前观测已有信息的内容时，想象最为有用；而当动作选择在很大程度上由观测驱动，或依赖于难以紧凑捕捉的动力学时，其好处可能会减弱。 因此，一个自然的下一步是让想象具有选择性，允许智能体决定何时想象以及想象多远，而不是在所有状态和任务上统一应用固定的展开步数。

paragraphs.en: Operating directly in a compact latent space avoids the cost of reconstructing future observations, but introduces a fundamental trade-off between abstraction and decision sufficiency. Representations that discard visually incidental details may also remove fine-grained dynamics that later become relevant for control, particularly in contact-rich interaction. Moreover, errors in latent transitions and reward prediction can accumulate during planning, making long-horizon rollouts increasingly unreliable. Our current deterministic latent dynamics do not explicitly represent such uncertainty, leaving the policy unable to distinguish a confident prediction from an ambiguous one. These limitations suggest that stronger latent world models may need to learn not only what is predictable, but what must be preserved for downstream decisions, together with uncertainty estimates that determine how far imagined experience should be trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 直接在紧凑的潜空间中操作可以避免重构未来观测的代价，但在抽象性与决策充分性之间引入了根本性的权衡。 丢弃视觉上偶然细节的表示，也可能移除那些随后对控制变得相关的细粒度动态，尤其是在富接触的交互中。 此外，潜变量转移和奖励预测中的误差会在规划过程中累积，使得长时程推演越来越不可靠。 我们目前确定性的潜变量动态并未显式地表示这种不确定性，使得策略无法区分一个置信的预测与一个模糊的预测。 这些局限表明，更强的潜变量世界模型可能不仅需要学习什么是可预测的，还需要学习哪些内容必须为下游决策而保留，同时学习能够决定想象经验应被信任到何种程度的不确定性估计。

paragraphs.en: Our current evidence is limited to a single VLM backbone and five simulated interactive visual environments, and therefore does not yet establish how the same design scales with model capacity, richer action spaces, or real-world interaction. In addition, although the latent world is represented within the VLM, its representation is grounded using a frozen pretrained visual encoder; whether equally useful predictive structure can emerge solely from interaction remains an open question. Latent imagination is also not computationally free: while Dwell substantially reduces end-to-end GPU-hours relative to a generative world model, simpler latent dynamics remain cheaper, revealing a performance–compute trade-off rather than an absolute efficiency advantage. Extending this framework to larger VLMs, transferable world representations, and persistent learning across tasks and environments would be important steps toward agents that continually refine a shared model of their experience.

sents.en: Extending this framework to larger VLMs, transferable world representations, and persistent learning across tasks and environments would be important steps toward agents that continually refine a shared model of their experience.
sents.zh: 将这一框架扩展到更大的 VLM、可迁移的世界表示以及跨任务和环境的持续学习，将是迈向能够不断精炼其共享经验模型的智能体的重要步骤。

paragraphs.en: We presented Dwell , a model-based RL framework that enables VLM agents to learn from experience in their own latent worlds. Rather than treating the world model as a separate simulator that reconstructs future observations, Dwell recasts the VLM as a recurrent latent transition operator and uses a shared representational interface for prediction, value estimation, and action. By interleaving real interaction with latent imagination, the agent can reuse limited environmental experience to improve its policy without generating future observations explicitly. Across diverse interactive visual environments, Dwell achieves strong overall performance under controlled interaction budgets while substantially reducing the computational cost of imagination relative to generative world models. Taken together, these results suggest that a useful world model need not reproduce the world itself; it needs to predict a future that the agent can directly act and learn upon.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Dwell，一个基于模型的强化学习框架，使 VLM 智能体能够在自身的潜在世界中从经验中学习。 Dwell 并不把世界模型当作一个重建未来观测的独立模拟器，而是将 VLM 重塑为一个循环的潜在转移算子，并为预测、价值估计和动作使用共享的表征接口。 通过将真实交互与潜在想象交替进行，智能体可以复用有限的环境经验来改进其策略，而无需显式地生成未来观测。 在多样的交互式视觉环境中，Dwell 在受控交互预算下取得了强劲的整体性能，同时相对于生成式世界模型大幅降低了想象的计算成本。 综合来看，这些结果表明，一个有用的世界模型不必复现世界本身；它只需预测一个智能体能够直接据此行动和学习的未来。

paragraphs.en: A central design choice in Dwell is that the world model and policy operate on the same latent state interface: predicted states can therefore be consumed directly by the policy without an additional representation conversion. To isolate the effect of this design, we construct a bridged variant in which the world model retains its own latent representation and a lightweight learned adapter maps predicted states into a policy-specific latent space before action selection. All other components, including the VLM backbone, world-model objectives, policy optimization, imagination horizon, and online training schedule, are kept unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: Dwell 的一个核心设计选择是让世界模型与策略（policy）作用于同一个潜在状态接口：因此预测出的状态可以直接被策略使用，无需额外的表示转换。 为了隔离这一设计的影响，我们构建了一个桥接变体：其中世界模型保留自己的潜在表示，并由一个轻量的可学习适配器在动作选择之前将预测状态映射到策略专属的潜在空间。 所有其他组件，包括 VLM 骨干网络、世界模型目标、策略优化、想象时长以及在线训练计划，均保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 lists the settings that define Dwell ’s training pipeline in each environment. Three protocol details matter for reading the results. (i) Imagined actions are sampled from the current policy throughout latent rollouts.
